authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, local SHA256 1ed2e02722862188120da606e4b6a816fa4014c96de68da2f84a2ecda09461e7; sections 2.13, 20.1, 20.4.97, 20.4.101.1 and 20.4.102. The specification introduces CELLSTYLEMAP in 2008; its AC1018 occurrence here is an out-of-version producer backsave, not general version authority. General CMC semantics for packed 0xc8000000 and codepage byte 45 are not inferred. ODA XRECORD description uses RC length whereas this producer's observed legacy payload uses RS; the verifier pins the latter as a profile, not a general rule.

graph.entry: TABLE 0x9c's 0xbb extension dictionary links to 0xbc roundtrip XRECORD; its separately recorded child graph includes TABLECONTENT, TABLEGEOMETRY and DATATABLE. See p5-ac1018-table-descendant-graph-wire-2026-11-11.json; this verifier does not recapture the TABLE or 0xbb.
graph.style_root: NOD 0xc -> dictionary 0x6a -> Standard TABLESTYLE 0x6b. Dictionary 0x6a: data bits 71..173; owner H4=0xc, reactor H4=0xc, entry H2=0x6b. TABLESTYLE: data bits 79..1920; owner H4=0x6a, reactors H4=0x6a,0x9c, xdict H3=0xdb, three row text styles H5=0x11.
graph.style_extension: Dictionary 0xdb: data bits 63..607, hardOwner=1, names ACAD_XREC_ROUNDTRIP then ACAD_ROUNDTRIP_2008_TABLESTYLE_CELLSTYLEMAP; owner H4=0x6b, entries H2=0xdc and H2=0xdd. ODA output remaps 0xdb->0x12b, 0xdc->0x12c, 0xdd->0x12d and emits dictionary entries reversed, with group 360. The wire H2 and output 360 are recorded independently and not equated as role semantics.
graph.xrecord: 0xdc data begins bit 81, 89 bytes, ending bit 793; clone BS1 to bit 803; H4 owner and reactor 0xdb. Its exact ten typed items and order are checked against LibreDWG and ODA DXF. Four ASCII strings carry byte 45; this cannot resolve non-ASCII codepage semantics. See p5-ac1018-xrecord-codepage45-utf8-controlled-probe-2026-11-11.json.
graph.cellstylemap: 0xdd source body bits 89..5287 contains style IDs [3,1,2] named [_DATA,_TITLE,_HEADER]; individual spans [89,1803), [1803,3557), [3557,5287). Handle tail bits 5287..5655 has H4 owner and reactor 0xdb, followed by three repetitions of H5 STYLE 0x11 and six H5 LTYPE 0x14. ODA DXF orders styles [1,2,3]; comparison is by ID, not ordinal. All three styles and eighteen borders match the independent LibreDWG selected fields and same-vendor DXF observed fields. One zero pad bit follows. AC1018 typed parser recognizes this bounded shape but validateDwgPayload(AC1018) remains false.
graph.additional_resources: STYLE 0x11 Standard (font arial.ttf) owned by STYLE_CONTROL 0x3; LTYPE 0x14 ByBlock owned by LTYPE_CONTROL 0x5. TABLE 0x9c refers to LAYER 0x10 and block 0x9d. Peer reports LAYER xdict 0xc7, plotstyle 0x0f and linetype 0x16; block 0x9d owns 15 entities and BLOCK/ENDBLK 0xa6/0xa7 with TABLE backreference. These are peer observations, not closed or validated dependencies in this receipt. Native font availability and semantics are separate.

Add generated controls for boundary/tag/role/owner/order mutation, truncation, reset and failure/retry; exercise physical capture separately. Do not emit or claim graph closure until source-frame association, TABLE-to-style binding, full TABLE extension subtree, style dictionary and CELLSTYLEMAP dependencies (including STYLE/LTYPE control/name/font/linetype semantics), layer/plotstyle/xdict, owned block content, destination handle mapping, ordered entry policy and strict whole-graph output/readback are established. Independent producer/consumer semantic evidence and broader version/native platform qualification remain separate. A same-vendor converter roundtrip and an observer-only parse cannot promote support claims.
